To treat a nosebleed properly, you should follow standard first-aid procedures:
1. Sit upright to reduce blood pressure in the veins of your nose, which discourages further bleeding.
2. Lean forward slightly. Leaning back or lying down can cause the blood to flow down the back of your throat, which can lead to swallowing blood, coughing, or choking.
3. Breathe through your mouth while pinching the soft part of your nose shut.

Looking at the options:
(A) You should tilt your head back - Incorrect (this causes blood to flow down the throat).
(B) You should lean forward and breathe through your mouth - Correct.
(C) You should lie down - Incorrect (this also encourages swallowing blood).

Final answer: B
